integrity: Exact rational coefficients and a standalone reproducibility program; scientific result has same-model review only, without independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact positive-step cutoff shown only for s=2,d=3; all-stage d>=3 claims assert eventual negativity, not an all-step classification; floating point and intermediate stages are excluded.
title: Hypercube dimension barriers and a sharp three-cube threshold for Gauss–Legendre heat steps
